headline: Application role gains permission to read and write all S3 buckets in the account instead of two specific ones
suppressed: The cost reviewer found no cost impact. The security and reliability findings both correctly identified the same privilege-escalation issue.

findings.evidence_ref: variables.tf: `app_data_bucket_arns` default changed from specific bucket ARNs (`acme-prod-data` and `acme-prod-data/*`) to wildcard `["*"]`
findings.explanation: The app role will now have S3 read/write access to every bucket in the account. If the application or its credentials are compromised, all S3 data becomes accessible to the attacker, not just the intended reporting buckets.
